title: Weekend Football League
organizer: City Youth Sports Club & MY Bharat
description: Friendly 7-a-side matches focused on camaraderie, teamwork, and stamina. Open to all fitness levels.
whatToBring: Sports shoes, water bottle, and athletic wear

title: Acoustic Jam & Music Band
description: Learn acoustic guitar chords, cajón beats, and harmonize indie and classic songs with fellow students.
whatToBring: Your instrument or just your voice

title: Watercolour & Canvas Circle
description: Calming, mindful painting sessions exploring watercolours, charcoal sketches, and expressive modern art.
whatToBring: Sketchbook; paints and brushes are provided

title: Youth Community Clean-up & Tree Plantation
schedule: First Sunday of each month · 7:30 AM
description: Transform urban green spaces, plant indigenous saplings, and earn government youth volunteering hours.
whatToBring: Gardening gloves, comfortable shoes, sun cap

title: Spoken Word & Open Mic Poetry
description: A supportive, judgment-free space to recite your original poetry, stories, and spoken-word rhymes.

title: Sunrise Yoga & Breathwork
description: Invigorating surya namaskars, mindful pranayama, and sound meditation to reset dopamine and lower cortisol.
whatToBring: Yoga mat and light cotton clothes

title: Contemporary & Hip-Hop Crew
description: High-energy choreography sessions focusing on rhythm, footwork, and freestyle expression.

title: Tech & UI/UX Builders Club
description: Build real Android apps, Figma designs, and open-source civic technology tools with senior mentors.

title: Badminton Singles & Doubles
description: High-speed reflex building, cardio sprints, and competitive ladder matches in a friendly community.

title: Digital Photography & Photo Walk
description: Street photography walks capturing morning golden hour light, architecture, and candid human stories.
whatToBring: Any camera or smartphone with decent camera

title: Classical & Fusion Percussion
description: Learn basic bols on tabla, dholak, and mridangam with cross-genre polyrhythmic exercises.

title: Table Tennis Fast Rallies
description: Quick-fire ping pong tournaments and spin coaching for both beginners and ranked players.

title: Storytelling & Theatre Improv
description: Improv comedy games, voice modulation exercises, and social-impact street play (nukkad natak) rehearsals.

title: Evening Cycling Brigade
description: Scenic 15km suburban group cycling tours with safety marshals and illuminated night gear.

title: Animal Shelter Volunteering
description: Feed rescued puppies, assist veterinary caregivers with grooming, and promote stray adoptions.
whatToBring: Comfortable clothes you don't mind getting dusty

title: Slam Poetry & Hindi Shayri
description: Celebration of contemporary ghazals, free verse, and Urdu-Hindi couplets addressing youth empowerment.
whatToBring: Your verses and an attentive ear

title: Pottery & Clay Sculpting
description: Tactile therapy with terracotta clay, pottery wheel shaping, and hand-moulded miniature pots.

title: Debate & Public Speaking Society
description: Master structured parliamentary argumentation, deconstruct fallacies, and develop unshakable charisma.

title: Bollywood & Folk Fitness Dance
description: Burn 400+ calories while smiling to energetic Garba, Bhangra, and Bollywood dance cardio.

title: Chess & Tactical Strategy Club
description: Blitz 5+3 clock battles, opening theory masterclasses, and endgame puzzle problem-solving.
whatToBring: Chess set if you own one (boards provided)

title: Calisthenics & Bodyweight Strength
description: Progressive pull-ups, dips, handstand balance, and functional core strength with zero equipment.

title: Teaching Rural Children (NSS Outreach)
description: Teach basic mathematics, English reading, and computer literacy to underprivileged schoolchildren.

title: Basketball Half-Court 3x3
description: Fast-paced half-court 3-on-3 hoops with music, shot clock drills, and tournament brackets.

title: Choir & Vocal Harmony Practice
description: Soprano, alto, tenor, and bass four-part choral harmonies across traditional Indian and world melodies.

title: Cooking & Nutrition Workshop
description: Budget-friendly student meal prep, healthy overnight oats, protein bowls, and immunity drinks.
whatToBring: Small apron and lunch box for tasting
